entries.f7c784ffb24ca4ce: Building on gelatin manufacturing that began in 1918, the group handles everything from gelatin to collagen peptides, food materials and medical materials within a single group. Its distinguishing feature is a system in which it has production sites in each country matched to raw materials and products, such as bovine gelatin and collagen peptides in India and porcine gelatin in Canada, and brings researchers from each field together at its R&D and manufacturing building, Mirai-kan, to advance material development.
